newsitem.title: GERMANY: Cars pull German vehicle production lower in May.
newsitem.headline: Cars pull German vehicle production lower in May.

text.p: German vehicle production fell five percent in May from the same month a year ago to 400,300 units, the VDA German automobile association said on Thursday.
After the decline last month, the number of cars made here so far this year was virtually unchanged from a year earlier at 2,131,500 the association said.
In May alone, production of passenger cars and station wagons fell five percent to 375,300 units from the same month in 1996, but truck prodcution climbed 10 percent to 25,000.
Truck production during the month got a particular boost from vehicles weighing over six tonnes, up 16 percent, while production of trucks weighing less than six tonnes rose by seven percent.
Total vehicle exports during May declined by two percent to 232,000 units, but were up five percent to 1,276,800 units so far this year.
